title: One single flow, <1>from end to end</1>.
lead: From the first contact to closure, every phase of the service is designed, connected and measured. These are not independent processes: it is a system that works in an integrated way.

stages.d: To the right resource: capability, brand, geography.
Technical knowledge applied to every case.
Resolution verified with the end customer.

subtitle: Every layer of the service, <1>under control</1>.
has: A direct impact on cost, quality and time.
synthesis: Designed to work as a system, <1>not as isolated areas</1>.

kpis.d: A defined owner for each service layer.
Metrics aligned with cost, quality and time.
Early detection of deviations and continuous improvement.
Direct link between execution and outcome.
